title: Israel Police shut down internal apps including Mesironet over leak risk, israelinfo reports
date_note: israelinfo, published 24 Nov 2026, says it began the day before yesterday, on Sunday.
summary: israelinfo reports that Israel Police shut down several internal systems, including the Mesironet messaging service, on its own initiative because of a risk that confidential information could leak. The police called it a complex technological incident. The article says the cause is unclear, a cyberattack is among possibilities and an external failure is also being checked. It says police employees must change passwords.
plain: Israel Police switched off internal work apps over a possible leak of confidential data; the cause is unclear, israelinfo says.
exec: Israel Police internal systems were shut down over a possible leak risk; israelinfo says the cause is not yet known.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Per israelinfo, police staff must change their passwords.

sources.name: israelinfo: Полиция отключила рабочие приложения 100 тысячам сотрудников из-за угрозы утечки
